title: Branch protection evidence file
description: Self-attested branch protection posture for a GitHub repository default branch. Place at .oss-policy-kit/evidence/branch-protection.json. This file is trust-level: self-attested (maintainer-supplied, not platform-verified).

schema_version.description: Schema identifier for this evidence file format.

attested_at.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the maintainer last verified these settings.

attested_by.description: GitHub username or team identifier of the person attesting this file.

branch.description: Default branch name this evidence applies to (e.g. 'main', 'master').

protections.description: Boolean flags for each branch protection dimension.

require_pull_request_reviews.description: At least one required reviewer before merge.

dismiss_stale_reviews.description: Stale pull request approvals are dismissed when new commits are pushed.

require_status_checks.description: One or more status checks are required to pass before merging.

enforce_admins.description: Branch protections apply to administrators as well.

restrict_force_push.description: Force pushes to the protected branch are blocked.

required_linear_history.description: Merges that create a non-linear history are blocked (optional field).

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about deviations or context.
